exposure: pulsed dye laser (PDL) combined with triamcinolone intralesional injection (TAILI)
VSS of the previous CS scar
cohort: 35 patients who underwent early intervention using PDL and TAILI after removal of hypertrophic CS scars
finding: Early intervention using PDL combined with TAILI after surgical removal of hypertrophic Cesarean section (CS) scars was associated with significantly lower VSS scores.
